# Capstone Logistics, LLC

Capstone Logistics, LLC is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Capstone Logistics is a third-party logistics (3PL) company that provides warehouse management and transportation services for supply chain operations. Capstone Logistics, LLC employs 8,035 people (+11.9% YoY, +854 people) and has an annual revenue of $1.9B, founded in 1986. Headquartered in Peachtree Corners, Georgia, United States, with an office in Peachtree City. Its workforce is distributed across 17 countries (including United States, Canada, Egypt, France, and Colombia).

## About

Capstone Logistics is a leading third-party logistics (3PL) provider with a performance-based model built to improve efficiency and lower costs across the supply chain — running Warehousing, Transportation, and Performance operations at scale. Backed by 22,000+ team members, 700+ warehouse sites, and 18M+ shipments managed annually, Capstone delivers the accountability that today's largest retail, grocery, and manufacturing supply chains run on. 

Capstone's model is built around three solution areas. Warehouse Management covers full-service operations, inbound unloading, outbound selection, manufacturing support, and warehouse automation inside the four walls. Transportation Services connect those operations to the final consumer through last-mile delivery, cross-docking, yard management, and dedicated fleets. Performance Solutions layers on tactical labor support, pay-for-performance engineering, and the APEX technology suite to stabilize, scale, or transform an operation under pressure. 

Automation alone doesn't move a supply chain. Capstone pairs a performance-based business model with real people managing the supply chain at scale — the combination that lowers costs, increases value, and reduces risk for partners who need more than a vendor relationship. 

Headquartered in Peachtree Corners, GA, Capstone partners with recognized brands across retail, grocery, automotive, food manufacturing, home improvement, and healthcare. 

Learn more at capstonelogistics.com. 

Looking for your next career? Visit https://www.capstone.jobs/us/en
